description:
Return claims about EET 2.0 that circulate in media and on commercial websites but contradict the adopted law or official Finanční správa information — each with what actually applies, a dated "as of", our opinion (clearly labelled) and sources. Use it to fact-check a claim before answering.

Args:
  - query (string, optional): filter by words, e.g. "leden", "50 000", "POK", "karta".
  - response_format ('markdown'|'json').

Returns: items [{id, question, claim, truth, comment, as_of, sources, url}], page_url.
name: eet_list_misconceptions
title: List common misconceptions about EET 2.0
